Tests SBPF loader handling of duplicate entrypoint symbols and zero text sections.

# Purpose
This file is a small C test program for the `fd_sbpf_loader` code. It loads two ELF fixtures, `duplicate_entrypoint_entry.elf` and `zero_text_cnt.elf`, and checks how `fd_sbpf_program_load` handles entrypoint symbols and text section counts. The test builds a syscall table from the `_syscalls` list, creates an `fd_sbpf_program_t`, and verifies `prog->calldests` and `prog->entry_pc` after load. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up scratch memory, runs both tests, and then shuts down the runtime.
